system.description: Blood-and-battle god of honor who craves the blood of strong foes in worthy fights and scorns killing the weak or innocent.
system.summary: Blood-and-battle god of honor who craves the blood of strong foes in worthy fights and scorns killing the weak or innocent.
commandments: Shed blood for him, yours or the enemy's, and never flinch from violence.
Distrust magic and do not study it; it is for weaklings.
Fight honorably and never prey on the defenseless.
directives: All bloodshed pleases him; both killing and dying in his name are glorious.
Dedicate each victory to him; if you cannot stand proud over the foe, it was no victory.
Unleash your rage on the world instead of restraining it.
Keep your dignity before Khorne and never disgrace him.
Win through hard effort, avoiding tricks, sorcery and technology beyond what is needed.

cults.name: The Dethkvlt
cults.summary: Ritual killers who initiate by slaying an armed foe barehanded and hunt only dangerous prey, deliberately evening the odds.

cults.name: Outer Heaven
cults.summary: Heirs of a destroyed mercenary space station where soldiers were honored; its scattered enclaves insist that everyone on a mission fights.
